## 修改 / Change

问题、改动和原因。Problem, change and reason.

## 来源 / Source

关联已有任务；独立小改说明原因即可，不必先建 Issue。Link an existing task or explain an independent fix.

## 验证 / Validation

检查方法、结果和仍待确认的部分。Checks, results and remaining review.

## 接收位置 / Destination

确认仓库和目标分支；跨仓用完整引用。Confirm repository and branch; qualify cross-repository references.
